desc: Ideation and algorithm selection: DSU over values <= threshold with latest-multiple witness.
Implement the complete solution in the starter code: DSU, present marking, isolated > threshold count, multiple-scan union, and final component count.
Test against the provided examples and edge cases: all nums > threshold, threshold = 1, nums contains 1, and large threshold.
Verify complexity is O(n + T log T) time and O(T) memory, where T = threshold.
